string.text: Listen, Marked One: I saved you, and I will not play the noble type. You do a couple of jobs for me and we are even.
We will see how fast your head clears up after the amnesia, and I will try to dig up something on your case.
Who knows why this Strelok matters to you, but I stay out of other people's business.
You want him dead, so there must be a reason.
So, I found out a few things about Strelok.
There was a stalker like that.
They say he found a way to the North.
I would love to know how he got through.
Untouched places, an artifact goldmine.
Anyway, the other traders and I will help you find him.
And maybe you will find that hidden path yourself.
And things will be good for all of us.
You take Strelok down, and we open the road North.
Unlikely to work, but as they say, no risk, no champagne.
Well, why are you standing there? Come on over, I do not bite.
Come here. We need to clear up the situation.
Well, hello!
You are back.
Brought any loot?
Got anything worth my while?
What did you drag in?
Well, go get some air, then come back.
Good hunting, stalker.
This is your personal PDA.
This handy gadget will help you survive in the Zone.
And if you die anyway, others will at least know where and how.
Just kidding.
Here, let me remind you how to use it.
Your tasks are in the first section of the PDA.
Most tasks have buttons that give you additional information on the task.
Remember, each new task is shown automatically on your mini-map.
Moving on. The second section of the PDA is the map.
The buttons above the map let you zoom in and out.
You can also center the map on yourself, and so on.
You will figure out the rest, it is not hard. The PDA also has a contacts section.
The contacts section lists the stalkers within 50 meters of you.
You can see a short description, rank, group and their likely attitude toward you.
Remember, while you are neutral, how other stalkers feel about you depends on you alone.
Notice how someone's attitude changes when you help them.
Be careful if enemies are around. They are marked red on the visor, friends green, neutrals yellow.
And PDAs of dead stalkers are gray. Handy if you like looting corpses.
What else? Oh yes, there is a diary too.
Well, what is there to say about it?
All the information you need is noted in your journal.
And the news, too.
Even what I am telling you right now can be found in this section.
Then there is the ranking section.
You can see the top 20 stalkers I know.
I refresh it from time to time to keep up the competitive spirit.
Maybe you will be at the top someday. Who knows?
Your own achievements are in the statistics section.
It is pretty much self-explanatory. And then there is the encyclopedia.
It holds information about the Zone, and survival tips you find or get from other stalkers.
That is basically it, I think.
Oh, one more thing. Your PDA has a wide-band radio scanner with a built-in decoder.
Its range is about 400 meters, so you can even listen in on military channels.
Mine reaches 30 kilometers, so I can always get in touch with you.
I will send you tasks and the latest news. At first I will give advice too.
So, is everything clear, or should I repeat?
To hop over a low obstacle, press $$ACTION_jump$$.
To duck under a low obstacle, press $$ACTION_crouch$$. To crouch lower, hold $$ACTION_accel$$ as well.
To run faster, hold $$ACTION_sprint_toggle$$ while moving. A sprinting stalker runs and jumps farther but tires quickly and cannot shoot.
Select the binoculars with $$ACTION_wpn_5$$ and press fire to zoom in on distant things.
Helping people raises their attitude toward you and your reputation. Traders sell cheaper to those they like. Shoot at someone and they and their friends will turn on you.
To talk to someone, aim at them and press $$ACTION_use$$.
Sidorovich can walk you through the PDA. Listen to him?
